rows.commentary: 6.5: Arafat Minhas loops it up on middle and off, and Kamindu Mendis steps forward to clip it straight to mid-wicket.
6.6: Arafat Minhas tosses this delivery on off, allowing Kamindu Mendis to punch it down to long-on for a single.
7.1: Shaheen Afridi lands it on a good length just outside off, met by a leaning defensive push from Kamindu Mendis into the off-side.
7.2: Shaheen Afridi probes with a fuller delivery outside off, steered firmly off the front foot straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
7.3: Shaheen Afridi pulls back his length outside off, and Kamindu Mendis angles the bat to dead-bat it toward the off-side.
7.4: Shaheen Afridi angles one into the left-hander from a length, nudged by Kamindu Mendis behind square on the on-side for a comfortable single.
7.5: Shaheen Afridi shortens his delivery and angles it across the right-hander, leaving Avishka Fernando to watch it pass.
7.6: Shaheen Afridi finds extra fullness outside off as Avishka Fernando drives loosely, skewing a thick edge off the bottom hand down to third man for a single.
8.1: Arafat Minhas fires it flatter and quicker onto the pads, completely beating Avishka Fernando's attempted flick.
8.2: Arafat Minhas tosses it up around off, and Avishka Fernando takes a half-stride forward to execute a solid defense.
8.3: Arafat Minhas floats this one just outside off, inviting Avishka Fernando to punch it straight back at the bowler.
8.4: Arafat Minhas tosses one up invitingly outside off, drawing Avishka Fernando into a drive down toward long-off for a comfortable single.
8.5: Arafat Minhas loops it up outside off, finding subtle turn into Kamindu Mendis, who dead-bats it securely into the leg-side.
8.6: Taking pace off at 89kph, Minhas darts one onto off-stump as Kamindu retreats onto the back foot to steer it toward midwicket.
9.1: Shaheen Afridi digs it in short, keeping it low, and Avishka Fernando pats a controlled pull over mid-wicket for a single.
9.2: Shaheen Afridi drops short, and Kamindu Mendis swivels effortlessly to launch the pull over backward square leg for a maximum that registers his fifty.
9.3: Shaheen rolls his fingers across a slower bouncer that catches Kamindu early on the hook, trickling off an inside edge safely short of the keeper.
9.4: Shaheen drifts a low full-toss in at the left-hander, prompting Kamindu to prod across the line and dab it towards mid-on.
9.5: Shaheen hammers another short delivery into the batter, allowing Kamindu to punch it down to long leg for a comfortable single.
20.2: Haris Rauf delivers at 140.1ks, but Kamindu Mendis checks his drive exquisitely to steer the ball past a diving Naseem at mid-off for four.
20.3: Haris Rauf pulls back his length to 136.9ks, cramping the batter before Mendis drops it softly into the off-side to sprint through for a quick single.
20.4: Haris Rauf digs a sharp bouncer close to off-stump, forcing Mendis to sink down and watch it sail harmlessly over him.
20.5: Haris Rauf lands a 136.4ks back-of-a-length delivery, which Mendis punches firmly toward backward point where Arafat makes an athletic stop.
20.6: Haris Rauf pitches slightly too full, and the Sri Lankan captain Kusal Mendis presents the full face of the bat to launch a commanding six straight down the ground.
21.1: Salman Agha tosses one up at 83.8ks outside off, allowing Mendis to drive in front of square for a single as the sweeper tidies up.
21.2: Salman Agha watches Kusal Mendis come down the pitch and almost york himself, squeezing the ball away to the cover region.
21.3: Salman Agha claims a stunning caught-and-bowled wicket as Kusal Mendis smokes it straight back, only for Agha to pluck a sensational reflex catch out of thin air.
21.4: Salman Agha tosses it up around off-stump, and Rathnayake safely blocks it down into the off-side.
21.5: Salman Agha induces a moment of hesitation as Rathnayake works it to mid-wicket, but Shaheen's fumble lets them complete the single safely.
21.6: Salman Agha fires one in with width, and Mendis expertly dabs it away late past the fielder to pick up another boundary.
22.1: Naseem Shah charges in to send down a 133.2ks full delivery at the stumps, comfortably eased toward mid-on by Rathnayake.
22.2: Naseem Shah delivers a fullish 137.2kph ball, and Pavan Rathnayake solidly drills it straight to the mid-off fielder.
22.3: Naseem Shah drops it back of a length at 137.6kph, allowing Pavan Rathnayake to nudge it softly into the off-side and flip the strike.

22.4: Naseem Shah angles a fuller delivery away as Kamindu Mendis checks his drive, sending it dropping dangerously close before Agha gathers it on the half-volley at cover to leave the bowler gripping his head in disbelief.
22.5: Naseem Shah fires a full delivery across the left-hander, and Kamindu Mendis slices his drive behind square on the off-side to scamper back for two runs.
22.6: Naseem Shah charges in with a 138.8kph good length ball, solidly blocked by Kamindu Mendis just ahead of mid-off as he sprints across for a single.
32.2: Haris Rauf drifts onto the pads, allowing Kamindu Mendis to tuck it into the gap at mid-wicket and advance to ninety-eight.
32.3: Haris Rauf delivers a slower off-cutter, knocked securely toward wide mid-on by Pavan Rathnayake.
32.4: Haris Rauf drops it short on middle, and Mendis pulls it away cleanly to deep mid-wicket.
32.5: Haris Rauf offers a slightly shorter delivery, which Rathnayake reads early, clearing his back leg to smash across the line into the deep mid-wicket gap for four.
32.6: Haris Rauf serves up a short and wide ball, flayed on the up by Rathnayake toward sweeper cover.
33.1: Faheem Ashraf bowls back of a length outside off, safely cut away to sweeper cover by Rathnayake.
33.2: Faheem Ashraf bangs it short on off, and Mendis waits to upper glide it toward third man, bouncing over the ropes to seal a maiden ODI hundred as the crowd and coach rise in applause.
33.3: Faheem Ashraf digs it slightly short again, gently guided down to third man by Mendis.
33.4: Faheem Ashraf angles into the pads, clipping uppishly toward the leg side where Rathnayake is brilliantly denied by the fielder.
33.5: Faheem Ashraf angles in from outside off, eased down to long-on by Rathnayake.
33.6: Faheem Ashraf stays short outside off, guided down to square third man by Mendis.
34.1: Haris Rauf fires it full on the pads, clipped away neatly to deep square leg by Mendis.
34.2: Haris Rauf digs it in short, and Pavan Rathnayake mistimes his pull straight towards mid-wicket to steal a single.
34.3: Haris Rauf strays with his line on a back-of-a-length delivery, allowing Kamindu Mendis to slash it past the keeper all the way to the third man fence for four.
34.4: Haris Rauf spears this full delivery angling in, and Kamindu Mendis guides it to square third man to bring up the double century for Sri Lanka.
34.5: Haris Rauf rolls his fingers over a slower, fuller ball, and Pavan Rathnayake simply works it into the mid-wicket sector.
34.6: Haris Rauf goes to the off-cutter once more, and Pavan Rathnayake can only push it straight to point without finding a gap.
44.3: Haris Rauf comes from round the wicket with a fuller length that Sahan Arachchige safely turns down the ground toward mid-on.
44.4: Haris Rauf angles a back-of-a-length delivery into the pads, eluding Janith Liyanage's bat as it ricochets off the thigh pad for a leg bye.
44.5: Haris Rauf nails a pinpoint yorker on off stump, leaving Sahan Arachchige just enough time to scramble and dig it out toward backward point.
44.6: Haris Rauf drops it shortish outside off, and Janith Liyanage expertly dabs it down to square third man for a comfortable single.
45.1: Shaheen Afridi hurls it full and tailing inward, forcing Janith Liyanage to work the delivery away toward mid-wicket for a single.
45.2: Shaheen Afridi slips in a precise, reversing yorker that Sahan Arachchige frantically digs out toward the cover region for one.
45.3: Shaheen Afridi drops it a fraction short outside off, allowing Janith Liyanage to cut it square through the off-side for a single.
45.4: Shaheen Afridi rolls his fingers across a slower delivery that sticks in the surface, inducing Sahan Arachchige to chip it aerially toward mid-wicket.
45.5: Shaheen Afridi deploys the off-cutter once more, trapping Sahan Arachchige as he fails to pierce the inner ring.
45.6: Shaheen Afridi angles one in sharply and full, eliciting a quick tap to cover from Sahan Arachchige to conclude a superb bowling stint.
46.1: Naseem Shah errs with a full back-of-the-hand slow leg-cutter, and Sahan Arachchige ruthlessly crashes it through the gap between extra cover and long-off for four.
46.2: Naseem Shah delivers from back of a length angling inward, prompting Sahan Arachchige to turn it toward wide mid-on for a single.
46.3: Naseem Shah digs out the low full-toss, and Janith Liyanage slices the aerial drive straight down the throat of Maaz Sadaqat prowling at deep point to depart for six.
